description.value: Table: Summon Monster IX Creature Subtype(s) Apocrypha (Chaotic, Demon, Evil, Extraplanar) Havocfang* [(holy/shadow)] Garulessa* [(holy/shadow)] Jackanapes (Devil, Evil, Extraplanar, Lawful) Pneumaflayer (Devil, Extraplanar) This spell functions like Summon Monster I , except that you can summon one creature from the 9th-level list with a CR rating of 14 or lower, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 8th-level list , or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 7th-level or lower lists.
